data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for making in-app purchases through the App Store and Google Play.
data.what_it_does: Provides a storefront-independent API to show available in-app products, load owned products, and purchase consumables, non-consumables, and subscriptions across Android, iOS, and macOS.
use_when: You need to sell digital goods or subscriptions inside your mobile or desktop app.
You want a unified API targeting both Google Play Billing and Apple App Store (StoreKit 1 & 2).
avoid_when: You are processing physical goods or general payment gateway transactions via web or external credit cards.
You do not want to configure store-specific items and developer accounts on Google Play and App Store.
strengths: Unified interface across Android, iOS, and macOS.
Stream-based architecture for listening to purchase updates.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration and store setup.
Consumable restoration must be handled manually via a custom backend.
data.setup_notes: Requires configuring products in Google Play Console and App Store Connect, setting up appropriate app signing/permissions, and handling native store SDK requirements.
